an10.15:1.1: yāvatā bhikkhave sattā apadā vā dipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññīnāsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsabbuddho.
an10.15:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
an10.15:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici jaṅgamānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ mahantattena,
an10.15:2.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
an10.15:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā, kūṭo tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
an10.15:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
an10.15:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci mūlagandhā, kāḷānusāriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati,
an10.15:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci sāragandhā lohitacandanaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati,
an10.15:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci pupphagandhā, vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati,
an10.15:7.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci kuḍḍarājāno, sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā bhavanti, rājā tesaṃ cakkavatti aggamakkhāyati,
an10.15:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā, sabbā tā candappabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ candappabhā tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati,
an10.15:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye viddho vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nāhaṃ abbhussukkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca.
an10.15:10.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathīdaṃ: gaṅgā, yamunā aciravatī, sarabhū, mahī, sabbā tā samuddaṅgamā samuddaninnā samuddaponā samuddapabbhārā, mahāsamuddo tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
an10.15:10.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyatīti.
